-- Counts every field goal attempt (made + missed) in the loaded dataset (2023-24 regular season only).
-- Note: free throws are not shots and are not included here.

FROM nba.shot_detail;

cases.sql:
-- "Most common shot zone" interpreted as shot_zone_basic with the highest number of field goal attempts (made + missed) in the 2023-24 regular season
SELECT shot_zone_basic, COUNT(*) AS attempts
FROM nba.shot_detail
GROUP BY shot_zone_basic
ORDER BY attempts DESC
LIMIT 1;
cases.summary: The Restricted Area is the most common shot zone in the 2023-24 regular season, accounting for 64,669 field goal attempts.

cases.sql:
-- Counting made 3-point field goals from shot_detail for the only loaded season (2023-24 regular season)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS three_pointers_made
FROM nba.shot_detail
WHERE season = 2023
  AND season_type = 'regular'
  AND shot_type = '3PT Field Goal'
  AND shot_made_flag = 1
cases.summary: There were 31,579 made three-point field goals in the 2023-24 regular season (the only season loaded in this dataset).

cases.sql:
-- Counts field goal attempts only (2PT + 3PT) from shot_detail; free throw attempts are not included since shot_detail has no free throw data.
SELECT player_name, COUNT(*) AS fg_attempts
FROM nba.shot_detail
WHERE player_name = 'Stephen Curry'
GROUP BY player_name;
cases.summary: Stephen Curry attempted 1,445 field goals in the 2023-24 regular season, per shot_detail; this excludes free throw attempts, which aren't recorded in this table.

cases.sql:

FROM nba.shot_detail

ORDER BY field_goal_attempts DESC
LIMIT 10
cases.summary: Ranking field goal attempts (shot_detail excludes free throws) in the 2023-24 regular season, Luka Doncic leads with 1,652 attempts, narrowly ahead of Jalen Brunson (1,648) and Anthony Edwards (1,558), rounding out the top 10.

cases.sql:
-- Field goal percentage (2PT + 3PT combined) for Nikola Jokic by shot zone, 2023-24 regular season
-- (shot_detail covers field goals only; free throws are not included since they have no shot zone)
SELECT
    shot_zone_basic,
    COUNT(*) AS attempts,
    SUM(shot_made_flag) AS makes,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(shot_made_flag) / COUNT(*), 1) AS fg_pct
FROM nba.shot_detail
WHERE player_name = 'Nikola Jokic'
  AND season = 2023
  AND season_type = 'regular'
GROUP BY shot_zone_basic
ORDER BY attempts DESC
cases.summary: For the 2023-24 regular season, Nikola Jokic shot best from the Restricted Area (70.2% on 477 attempts) and In The Paint (Non-RA) (61.7% on 535 attempts), with his Above the Break 3 shooting at 37.7% on 215 attempts; note this covers field goals only, as shot_detail excludes free throws.

cases.sql:
-- Restricting to 2023-24 regular season (only data loaded). Threshold: at least 200 three-point attempts.
SELECT
    player_name,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE shot_made_flag = 1) AS makes,
    COUNT(*) AS attempts,
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE shot_made_flag = 1) / COUNT(*), 1) AS three_pt_pct
FROM nba.shot_detail
WHERE season = 2023
  AND season_type = 'regular'
  AND shot_type = '3PT Field Goal'
GROUP BY player_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 200
ORDER BY three_pt_pct DESC
LIMIT 10;
cases.summary: Among 2023-24 regular season players with at least 200 three-point attempts, Grayson Allen led with a 46.1% three-point percentage (205/445), followed by Luke Kennard at 45.0% (107/238) and Mike Conley at 44.2% (179/405).

cases.sql:
-- Assists are only recorded on made field goals (eventmsgtype = 1) via player2_name.
-- Excluding rows where player2_id = 0 (no assist on that made shot).
-- Restricting to season = 2023, season_type = 'regular' since that's the only data loaded, which also helps the query use available indexes efficiently.
SELECT player2_name AS player, COUNT(*) AS assists
FROM nba.pbp_event
WHERE eventmsgtype = 1
  AND season = 2023
  AND season_type = 'regular'
  AND player2_id <> 0
GROUP BY player2_id, player2_name
ORDER BY assists DESC
LIMIT 10
cases.summary: Tyrese Haliburton led the 2023-24 regular season with 752 assists, followed closely by Nikola Jokic (708) and Luka Doncic (686), rounding out the top 10 most prolific playmakers.

cases.sql:
-- Turnovers are eventmsgtype = 5 in nba.pbp_event.
-- Team turnovers (e.g. shot-clock violations attributed to the team) have player1_name NULL and are excluded.
-- Only the 2023-24 regular season is loaded.
SELECT
    player1_name AS player,
    COUNT(*) AS turnovers
FROM nba.pbp_event
WHERE season = 2023
  AND season_type = 'regular'
  AND eventmsgtype = 5
  AND player1_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY player1_name
ORDER BY turnovers DESC
LIMIT 10;
cases.summary: Luka Doncic led the 2023-24 regular season with 282 turnovers, narrowly ahead of Domantas Sabonis (272) and Victor Wembanyama (260); the list shows the top 10 players by turnover count.

cases.sql:
-- Only 2023-24 regular season data is loaded (season=2023, season_type='regular').
-- Free throws live in nba.pbp_event (eventmsgtype = 3); a miss is any description starting with 'MISS'.
SELECT
    player1_name AS player_name,
    COUNT(*) AS free_throw_attempts,
    SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(homedescription, visitordescription, neutraldescription) NOT LIKE 'MISS%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS free_throws_made,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(homedescription, visitordescription, neutraldescription) NOT LIKE 'MISS%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / COUNT(*), 1
    ) AS free_throw_pct
FROM nba.pbp_event
WHERE season = 2023
  AND season_type = 'regular'
  AND eventmsgtype = 3
GROUP BY player1_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 300
ORDER BY free_throw_pct DESC;
cases.summary: Among 2023-24 regular-season players with at least 300 free throw attempts, Stephen Curry led with a 92.3% free throw percentage (299/324), narrowly ahead of Damian Lillard at 92.0% (473/514); 43 players met the 300-attempt threshold.

cases.sql:
-- Three-point shots taken in the final two minutes (game clock <= 2:00) of the 4th quarter
-- Only 2023-24 regular season data is loaded, so results reflect that season only.
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS three_pt_attempts,
    SUM(shot_made_flag) AS three_pt_makes,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(shot_made_flag) / COUNT(*), 1) AS three_pt_pct
FROM nba.shot_detail
WHERE shot_type = '3PT Field Goal'
  AND period = 4
  AND (minutes_remaining < 2 OR (minutes_remaining = 2 AND seconds_remaining = 0));
cases.summary: In the 2023-24 regular season, players shot 29.7% (1,217 makes on 4,091 attempts) on three-pointers taken in the final two minutes of the fourth quarter.

cases.sql:
-- Corner three share = (Left Corner 3 + Right Corner 3 attempts) / total 3PT attempts, per team.
-- Only the 2023-24 regular season is loaded, so this reflects that season only.
-- No size was specified for "which teams", so returning the top 10 by corner-three share.
SELECT
    team_name,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE shot_zone_basic IN ('Left Corner 3', 'Right Corner 3')) AS corner_three_attempts,
    COUNT(*) AS total_three_attempts,
    ROUND(
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE shot_zone_basic IN ('Left Corner 3', 'Right Corner 3'))::NUMERIC
        / COUNT(*), 4
    ) AS corner_three_share
FROM nba.shot_detail
WHERE shot_type = '3PT Field Goal'
GROUP BY team_name
ORDER BY corner_three_share DESC
LIMIT 10;
cases.summary: For the 2023-24 regular season, the Miami Heat took the highest share of their three-point attempts from the corners (824 of 2,765 threes, or 29.8%), narrowly ahead of the Minnesota Timberwolves (29.3%) and Utah Jazz (28.8%); the top 10 teams by this measure are shown.

cases.sql:
-- Points = field goals (2 or 3 pts, from shot_detail) + made free throws (1 pt each, from pbp_event).
-- Only season 2023 regular season is loaded, so this covers 2023-24 regular season only.
WITH fg_points AS (
    SELECT player_id, player_name,
           SUM(CASE WHEN shot_type = '3PT Field Goal' THEN 3 ELSE 2 END) AS pts
    FROM nba.shot_detail
    WHERE shot_made_flag = 1
      AND season = 2023
      AND season_type = 'regular'
    GROUP BY player_id, player_name
),
ft_points AS (
    SELECT player1_id AS player_id, player1_name AS player_name,
           COUNT(*) AS pts
    FROM nba.pbp_event
    WHERE eventmsgtype = 3
      AND season = 2023
      AND season_type = 'regular'
      AND COALESCE(homedescription, visitordescription, neutraldescription) NOT LIKE 'MISS%'
    GROUP BY player1_id, player1_name
),
combined AS (
    SELECT * FROM fg_points
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM ft_points
)
SELECT player_name, SUM(pts) AS total_points
FROM combined
GROUP BY player_id, player_name
ORDER BY total_points DESC
LIMIT 10;
cases.summary: Combining field goals from shot_detail with made free throws from pbp_event for the 2023-24 regular season, Luka Doncic led all players with 2,370 total points, followed by Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (2,254) and Giannis Antetokounmpo (2,222).
